acceptance_criteria: Final audit gate validates schema/status for source JSON artifacts.
P14 remains dry-run-only, opt-in-only, and not counted as real Valkey coverage.
Rendered HTML, SVG, and CSV outputs are source_of_truth=false and link to hashed JSON source artifacts.
All missing-like metric statuses include reason and impact.
CI runs the final audit gate and schema validation without P14 opt-in or real wrapper invocations.

key_findings: P14 is not automatic and requires explicit opt-in.
Missing metrics must be encoded explicitly.
L10 requires a final full-chain audit gate, schema, CI coverage, and artifact-first rendered reports.
The implemented gate checks source schemas/status, coverage shape, P14 boundary, missing metric impacts, and report provenance.
The schema requires source_artifacts, generated_reports, invariant_results, missing_metric_impacts, and p14_boundary.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN in CI or final audit.
Do not count 1000-dry-run as real Valkey coverage.
Do not use rendered HTML, SVG, CSV, or markdown views as measured metric sources.

implementation_plan.rationale: The gate validates final full-chain artifact integrity and writes a schema-checked final audit report.
implementation_plan.step: Keep final audit as an artifact validation gate.

implementation_plan.rationale: Metric sources remain JSON artifacts, missing-like metrics carry reason and impact, and rendered outputs remain views.
implementation_plan.step: Keep metric and report changes artifact-first.

notes: Read-only implementation review approved the current L10 implementation. P14 was represented only through existing dry-run audit evidence and was not executed.
